snippet.title: the travelers - final trailer - releasing 12/19/2025
snippet.description:
discover what was hidden for you. learn why humanity was brought back.
wishlist on steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316690/the_travelers/

the travelers is a text-based adventure and mmo. the world is one massive space to be explored by all players at once, where history can be learned, items can be discovered, bases can be built, and combat can be engaged.

hidden within the wasteland is a grand puzzle that will take a collaborative community effort to solve. the world is very large and dangerous, and traveling takes time; with dozens of old transcripts from a forgotten civilization to read through, every hint matters toward learning your true purpose. together, you can uncover the secrets of the wasteland.

https://thetravelers.online
